title: Janice H NDE 4306
content: I was in a car driving towards the Coast of Oregon when my car went off the road and crashed. I was thrown out of the car, landed between two large boulders, and then the car landed on top of me. The two other passengers in the car were not injured. As I was being crushed by the car, I felt myself being squeezed so hard that my breath was leaving me and I thought to myself, 'Oh God, I am going to die.' About this time, I was being levitated to the sky. I looked down where my body was lying and my right leg was all twisted. I saw the two people that were traveling with me crying and were very upset over my injuries. The ambulance had arrived and the attendant was administering help to me. I watched them do what they could but I could not understand why everyone was so upset. I was feeling wonderful and happy. I knew that this was a wonderful thing that was happening to me. I continued to leave the scene of the accident and followed a bright light. I do not know how long this lasted but eventually I returned to my body. (It was after I had arrived at the hospital and had surgery.) I had remained in a coma for several days before I returned to consciousness. I suffered extensive internal injuries and a crushed right femur, pelvic bone and several other bones as well. It was an intense memory that I have never been able to forget. Even though it has been almost sixty years since the accident, I can remember the exact feelings of peacefulness, and happiness as if it happened to me yesterday. It took a long time before I ever told anyone about the experience because I did not think anyone would believe me.

elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Yes. My experience gave me a knowledge of the feeling of dying and I have no fear of it. The peace I felt during this episode was one of the most pleasant experiences of my life.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes It took me several years before I shared this experience with family members. Their reaction was one of wonder and some uncertainty over the accuracy.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I knew it was real. It had happened to me and I felt that this was a message from God that I was going to be okay and that there was no need for fear. I felt like it was my own special secret.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I still feel that it was a special gift given to me from God. It has made me a more trusting person and certainly more positive thinking.
